[[Laois GAA|Laois]] joined Division 1 as the promoted team. On 18 September 1966, [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] won the title after a 10-15 to 2-15 aggregate win over [[New York GAA|New York]] in the final. It was their 3rd league title overall and their first since [[1961-62 National Hurling League|1961-62]].{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} In spite of finishing at the bottom of their respective groups, neither [[Galway GAA|Galway]] of [[Laois GAA|Laois]] were relegated.
